name: health-evidence-companion
description: Adult informational symptom reasoning, safe self-care, medicine and research assistance; GitHub and manual distribution.

interface.longDescription: Help adults reason about symptoms and possible diagnoses, check self-diagnosis hypotheses, understand laboratory results, choose safe self-care and OTC label options, check medicine interactions and prepare clinician questions using current primary sources. Includes psychiatry information, evidence appraisal, private-record design and a study-to-GitHub-PR contribution workflow with maintainer review. English knowledge; answers in your language, with a short disclaimer in every health-facing answer. Not intended for use as a medical device, not clinically validated, and not a definitive diagnosis or prescription. No independent prescription changes, medical clearance or publisher patient archive. Distributed through GitHub and supported manual personal/workspace installation, without a required server or paid medical API. Platform policies and scans still apply; no directory approval or import success is promised. Actual cases never enter public knowledge.
defaultPrompt: Help me compare possible causes of these symptoms and safe next steps.
Check this medicine combination using current official labels.
Review this public study and prepare a knowledge pull request.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.3.0 targets GitHub/manual distribution, expands symptom reasoning and safe self-care, requires a short health disclaimer and adds connected-GitHub PR contribution instructions. Existing knowledge retained; no clinical validation or host approval claimed.
